study: Kather N49/k49 staged optimization and confidence-gated sparse-teacher distillation
kd_gate: Teacher argmax is correct AND its correct-label probability exceeds detached student correct-label probability
inference: Unmodified ScalingOptics N49/k49, original routing temperature0.05, no teacher, no new parameters
training: Same augmented TRAIN image to teacher and student; teacher frozen; full TRAIN and VAL metrics each epoch; batch progress each60s; reset AdamW, EMA initialized from selected source
selection: VAL accuracy then NLL, include source best; choose recipe before TEST; rollout to27/37 only if >=4 more correct VAL examples
supersedes: Stopped temperature annealing after four epochs without source VAL improvement; all artifacts preserved
